positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
I am primarily tasked with doing content migration, which is migrating content from custom coded html and react pages to CMS, while retaining styling and overall design. Implement changes on local environment. Deploy changes via GitHub according to CI/CD protocol. And QA changes in staging environments before deploying to production.
 Secondarily, I am tasked with creating landing page templates and 
implementing site wide SEO improvements including but not limited to: making
adjustments to metadata, on-page copy and styling revisions, page speed
optimizations, adding alt descriptions, and revising internal redirections.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Ruby on Rails · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Web Engineering · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

projects.title: Architectural Improvements for LLM Agents in Text-Based Games
projects.description: Investigated whether architectural modifications to LLM-based agents can improve spatial and temporal reasoning in text-based environments. Compared three architectures (BERT+GRU, BERT+Transformer, Mistral 7B+PPO) on TextWorld Commonsense tasks. Found that attention-based encoders achieved 333% improvement on in-distribution tasks, while decoder-only models showed 843% better out-of-distribution generalization.

projects.title: Blackjack Online: https://blackjack-frontend-tawny.vercel.app/
projects.description: Made an online blackjack game where users can play for free and try to earn trophies and build up a streak to achieve the most money as possible. In the future will work on making a better ui/ux and making a leaderboard for top users.

organizations.name: Brass Rat Investments
organizations.description: Brass Rat Investments is a student run hedge fund that recruits students from MIT. In order to join the hedge fund team, I am first taking a semester long training where I get taught the fundamentals of investing and being able to properly read a company’s financial report. By the end of the semester long program I will be able to effectively find great investments and create a presentation for why I picked my stock to buy. After taking the course, I can then interview to get into the team that runs the hedge fund, which runs $100,000 as of right now.

organizations.name: Computer Science Honor Society
organizations.description: As president, I gave advice to and taught incoming computer science students. Additionally, I coordinated weekly meetings to talk about community service ideas and help those without access to technology
